description_en: Call StartRecordTask to record a video task
kebab_example: aliyun rtc start-record-task --app-id yourAppId --channel-id yourChannelId --task-id yourTaskId --template-id 76dasgb0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartRecordTask

parameters.help_en: Specifies the list of users to which this task is subscribed
parameters.help_zh: 指定该任务订阅的用户列表
parameters.name: sub_spec_users

parameters.help_en: Specifies the audio streams of which users in the room to subscribe to
parameters.help_zh: 指定订阅房间里有哪些用户音频流
parameters.name: sub_spec_audio_users

parameters.help_en: Specifies the screen-sharing streams of which users in the room to subscribe to
parameters.help_zh: 指定订阅房间里有哪些用户屏幕共享流
parameters.name: sub_spec_share_screen_users

parameters.help_en: Specifies the camera streams of which users in the room to subscribe to
parameters.help_zh: 指定订阅房间里有哪些用户摄像头流
parameters.name: sub_spec_camera_users

parameters.help_en: Specifies the audio streams of which users in the room not to subscribe to
parameters.help_zh: 指定非订阅房间里有哪些用户音频流
parameters.name: unsub_spec_audio_users

parameters.help_en: Specifies the screen-sharing streams of which users in the room not to subscribe to
parameters.help_zh: 指定非订阅房间里有哪些用户屏幕共享流
parameters.name: unsub_spec_share_screen_users

parameters.help_en: Specifies the camera streams of which users in the room not to subscribe to
parameters.help_zh: 指定非订阅房间里有哪些用户摄像头流
parameters.name: unsub_spec_camera_users

fields.help_en:
The image display mode. Valid values:

0 (None): Not displayed.
1 (Always): Always displayed.
2 (Backup): Displayed when the current user has no video stream
fields.help_zh:
图片显示，取值：

0（None）：不显示。
1（Always）：总是显示。
2（Backup）：当前用户无视频流时显示
fields.name: display

fields.help_en: The pane height, as a normalized percentage
fields.name: height

fields.help_en: The HTTP or HTTPS address of the image
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The pane width, as a normalized percentage
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: The X coordinate, as a normalized percentage
fields.name: x

fields.help_en: The Y coordinate, as a normalized percentage
fields.name: y

fields.help_en: The stacking order. 0 is the bottom layer, layer 1 is above layer 0, and so on
fields.help_zh: 叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推
fields.name: z_order

fields.help_en: The list of image pane positions for the current layout
fields.help_zh: 当前布局的图片框位列表
fields.name: images

fields.help_en:
The pane ID. Valid values: 0 to 15.

If no user can be found for the specified PaneId, other streams are displayed by default. The streams are determined based on the order in which users join the channel.
If a parameter related to UserPanes is required, all other related parameters are also required. Otherwise, none of them is required
fields.help_zh:
窗格ID，取值：0~15。

当指定的PaneId用户找不到的话，会默认显示其他的流，流的确定是根据用户加入频道的顺序。
如果某个UserPanes相关的参数为必选，则其他相关参数都为必选，反之都为非必选
fields.name: pane_id

fields.help_en:
The user video input corresponding to the layout. Valid values:

camera (default): The video stream.
shareScreen: The screen-sharing stream
fields.help_zh:
对应布局的用户视频输入。取值：

camera（默认）：视频流。
shareScreen：共享屏幕流
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en: The font color (RGB). The calculation formula is R+G×256+B×65536. Valid values of R (red), G (green), and B (blue): 0 to 255
fields.help_zh: 文字颜色（RGB）。计算公式为R+G×256+B×65536，R（红）、G（绿）、B（蓝）的取值：0~255
fields.name: font_color

fields.help_en: The font size. The valid range of the font is (0, 72]
fields.help_zh: 字体大小。字体合理范围(0, 72]
fields.name: font_size

fields.help_en:
The font type. Valid values:

0 (default): NOTO_SERIF_CJKSC_REGULAR.
1: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_REGULAR.
2: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_BOLD.
3: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_Heavy.
4: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_LIGHT.
5: ALIBABA_PUHUITI_MEDIUM
fields.name: font_type

fields.help_en: The X coordinate, as a normalized percentage
fields.name: x

fields.help_en: The Y coordinate, as a normalized percentage
fields.name: y

fields.help_en: The stacking order. 0 is the bottom layer, layer 1 is above layer 0, and so on
fields.help_zh: 叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推
fields.name: z_order

fields.help_en: The list of text pane positions for the current layout
fields.help_zh: 当前布局的文字框位列表
fields.name: texts

fields.help_en: The user ID corresponding to the layout pane. Valid values of N: 1 to 16
fields.help_zh: 对应布局框格的用户ID。N的取值：1~16
fields.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The application ID. It is created and queried in the console. Only a single ID can be passed in
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. Only a single ID can be passed in
parameters.name: channel_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. Only a single ID can be passed in. It must be unique. It consists of 1 to 55 characters, including uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。仅支持传单个ID，需保证唯一。由1~55位大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The task billing configuration. Fees are charged based on your different settings. See the TaskProfile enumeration values below.

The resolution of the encoding option MediaEncode must be less than or equal to the resolution of TaskProfile.
The maximum number of layout panes must be less than or equal to the number of input streams of TaskProfile
parameters.help_zh:
任务计费配置，根据您的不同设置，进行收费。请参见下文中的TaskProfile枚举值。

编码选项MediaEncode的分辨率需要小于等于TaskProfile的分辨率。
布局最大窗格数需要小于等于TaskProfile的输入路数
parameters.name: task_profile

parameters.help_en: The encoding option. See the MediaEncode enumeration values below
parameters.help_zh: 编码选项，请参见下文中的MediaEncode枚举值
parameters.name: media_encode

parameters.help_en: The configuration template ID. To obtain the template ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193625.html
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The video source in single-stream recording mode. Valid values:

camera: The camera.
shareScreen: The screen sharing.

If the video source is shareScreen and only the camera stream is pushed, the camera stream is recorded. If the screen-sharing stream is also pushed, the screen-sharing stream is recorded
parameters.help_zh:
单流录制模式下视频源，取值：

camera：摄像头。
shareScreen：屏幕共享。

如果视频源为shareScreen，且仅推摄像头流，则录制摄像头流；如果同时推屏幕共享流，则录制屏幕共享流
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The single-stream recording mode. Valid values:

0 (default): Record the original stream.
1: Record only the audio stream
parameters.help_zh:
单流录制模式，取值：

0（默认值）：录制原始流。
1：仅录制音频流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
The recording mode. Valid values:

0: Single-stream recording. The task parameters cannot be modified in the middle of recording (the UpdateRecordTask operation cannot be called to modify the task parameters).
1 (default): Mixed-stream recording. Multi-pane mixed-stream output is supported.

Valid parameters in single-stream recording mode: StreamType and SourceType.
Valid parameters in mixed-stream recording mode: TaskProfile, MediaEncode, LayoutIds, BackgroundColor, SubSpecUsers, CropMode, UserPanes, Backgrounds, Watermarks, and ClockWidgets
parameters.help_zh:
录制模式，取值：

0：单流录制，不允许中间修改任务参数（不允许调用UpdateRecordTask接口修改任务参数）。
1（默认值）：合流录制，支持多画面合流输出。

单流录制模式下有效参数：StreamType、SourceType。
合流录制模式下有效参数：TaskProfile、MediaEncode、LayoutIds、BackgroundColor、SubSpecUsers、CropMode、UserPanes、Backgrounds、Watermarks、ClockWidgets
parameters.name: mix_mode

parameters.help_en:
The video cropping mode. Valid values:

1: Crop while maintaining the aspect ratio.
2: Add borders while maintaining the aspect ratio (default)
parameters.help_zh:
视频的裁剪方式。取值：

1：保持比例裁剪。
2：保持比例留边（默认值）
parameters.name: crop_mode
